component.name: StepAway
component.summary: Lock your computer when your phone moves away

description.p: StepAway locks this computer when your paired Android phone or watch moves out of range, and can optionally unlock it when you come back. Distance is estimated from the Bluetooth signal strength.
Everything stays on your devices: there are no accounts, no network access and no telemetry.

ul.li: Lock when your phone is away, switched off or out of range
Optional unlock on return, off by default
Pair with a QR code; signed rotating tokens
Pause media and close chosen apps when locking
